metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel workspace name (not the GUID). A new name is created as part of this deployment when DeployNewWorkspace is true.
true creates the workspace and enables Microsoft Sentinel on it. false uses an existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace in this resource group.
Region of the Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Leave the default unless the workspace is in a different region than this resource group.
Object ID of the Entra application's service principal (Enterprise applications > the app > Object ID). Empty: assign the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the data collection rule yourself.

content.json:
## SOCRadar alarms
Alarms the SOCRadar Alarms connector wrote to SOCRadar_Alarms_CL. Only the newest row per alarm counts.

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by Status
content.title: Alarms by status

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by AlarmMainType
| sort by Alarms desc
content.title: Alarms by main type

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by Severity
content.title: Alarms by SOCRadar severity

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: New alarms per day

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, Title, AlarmMainType, Severity, Status
content.title: Latest 50 alarms

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend TimeGenerated = now(), AlarmText = substring(AlarmText, 0, 4000), Severity = toupper(Severity), Status = toupper(Status)

properties.description: [concat('Raises one alert, and one incident, for every OPEN SOCRadar alarm of main type ', variables('ruleTypes')[copyIndex()], '. Switch the rule off to stop incidents for that type.')]
properties.query:
[concat('let alerted = SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AlertName startswith "[SOCRadar] #"
| extend AlertAlarmId = tostring(extract(@"#(\d+) ", 1, AlertName))
| distinct AlertAlarmId;
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1d)
| where ingestion_time() < ago(12m)
| where isnotempty(AlarmId)
| where column_ifexists("EventType", "") != "connection.test"
| where AlarmId !in (alerted)
| where ', if(equals(variables('ruleTypes')[copyIndex()], 'Other'), concat('AlarmMainType !in ', variables('knownTypesKql')), concat('AlarmMainType == "', variables('ruleTypes')[copyIndex()], '"')), '
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| where toupper(Status) == "OPEN"
| extend AlarmUrl = coalesce(column_ifexists("AlarmUrl", ""), strcat("https://platform.socradar.com/app/company/", CompanyId, "/alarm-management?tab=", iff(tostring(AlarmPayload.is_approved) == "false", "potential", "approved"), "&field=alarmId&operator=equals&value=", AlarmId))
| extend SentinelSeverity = case(toupper(Severity) in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High", toupper(Severity) == "MEDIUM", "Medium", "Low")
| extend AlarmContent = iff(gettype(AlarmPayload.content) == "dictionary", AlarmPayload.content, dynamic({}))
| mv-apply ContentKey = bag_keys(AlarmContent) to typeof(string) on (
    extend RawValue = trim(@"\s", replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(tostring(AlarmContent[ContentKey]), "\r", ""), "\n", " "), "`", "''"))
    | extend SafeValue = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(RawValue, "<", "<"), ">", ">"), "|", "\\|")
    | extend CellValue = case(
        isempty(RawValue), "-",
        RawValue startswith "[\"", replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(SafeValue, "[\"", ""), "\"]", ""), "\",\"", ", "), "\"", ""),
        RawValue startswith "{\"" or RawValue startswith "[{", replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(SafeValue, "[{", ""), "}]", ""), "},{", " / "), "\",\"", "; "), "\":\"", ": "), "\":", ": "), "\",", "; "), ",\"", "; "), "\"", ""), "{", ""), "}", ""),
        RawValue contains "://", SafeValue,
        replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(RawValue, "*", "\\*"), "_", "\\_"), "~", "\\~"), "[", "\\["), "]", "\\]"), "<", "<"), ">", ">"), "|", "\\|"))
    | summarize ContentRows = make_list(strcat("| ", replace_string(ContentKey, "_", " "), " | ", iff(strlen(CellValue) > 300, strcat(substring(CellValue, 0, 300), "..."), CellValue), " |")))
| extend ContentMarkdown = iff(array_length(ContentRows) == 0, "", strcat(substring(strcat("Content:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n", strcat_array(ContentRows, "\n")), 0, 2600), "\n\n"))
| mv-apply DetailWord = split(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(substring(AlarmText, 0, 1500), "\r", ""), "\n", " "), "`", "''"), "<", " <"), ">", "> "), " ") to typeof(string) on (
    summarize DetailWords = make_list(iff(DetailWord contains "://", DetailWord, replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(DetailWord, "*", "\\*"), "_", "\\_"), "~", "\\~"), "[", "\\["), "]", "\\]"), "<", "<"), ">", ">"), "|", "\\|"))))
| extend DetailsMarkdown = trim(@"\s", strcat_array(DetailWords, " "))
| extend DetailsMarkdown = strcat(substring(DetailsMarkdown, 0, 1500), iff(strlen(AlarmText) > 1500 or strlen(DetailsMarkdown) > 1500, "...", ""))
| extend DescriptionBody = strcat("SOCRadar Alarm\n\nAlarm ID: ", AlarmId, "\n\nMain Type: ", coalesce(AlarmMainType, "N/A"), "\n\nSub Type: ", coalesce(AlarmSubType, "N/A"), "\n\nSeverity: ", Severity, "\n\nStatus: ", Status, "\n\nCreated: ", AlarmDate, "\n\nDetails:\n", coalesce(DetailsMarkdown, "No details"), "\n\n", ContentMarkdown)
| extend DescriptionLink = strcat("View in SOCRadar: ", AlarmUrl)
| extend BodyBytes = strlen(base64_encode_tostring(DescriptionBody)) * 3 / 4, BodyBudget = 4800 - 2 * strlen(DescriptionLink)
| extend AlarmDescription = strcat(iff(BodyBytes > BodyBudget, strcat(substring(DescriptionBody, 0, toint(strlen(DescriptionBody) * 1.0 * BodyBudget / BodyBytes) - 10), "...\n\n"), DescriptionBody), DescriptionLink)
| extend AlarmDescription = iff(strlen(base64_encode_tostring(AlarmDescription)) * 3 / 4 > 4900, strcat(substring(DescriptionBody, 0, 1000), "...\n\n", DescriptionLink), AlarmDescription)
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, Title, AlarmDescription, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, AlarmDate, AlarmUrl, SentinelSeverity
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 149')]
